name: pi-openrouter-top
description: Replaces pi's OpenRouter model list with the top 50 models from https://openrouter.ai/models?order=top-weekly. Provider override is fed from ~/.pi/agent/openrouter-top50.json (a snapshot generated by scripts/sync-top50.mjs), so the ACB/pi picker shows exactly 50 curated-by-usage models instead of pi's ~300-model built-in snapshot.
